    Check the existence of one or more DOIs

    check_doi_exists.Rd

    Verifies whether one or more Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) actually exist, by normalizing the input string(s), validating their syntax, and querying the DOI resolution service (https://doi.org/api/handles/). DOIs with an invalid syntax are not queried over the network and immediately return NA.

    Usage

    check_doi_exists(doi, named = FALSE)

    Arguments

    doi

    A character vector of one or more DOIs. Accepted formats include raw DOIs ("10.xxxx/yyyy"), full URLs ("https://doi.org/10.xxxx/yyyy"), and "doi:"-prefixed strings. NA values are allowed and return NA in the result.

    named

    A single logical value. If TRUE, the returned vector is named using the normalized DOI strings. Default is FALSE.

    Value

    A logical vector of the same length as doi, where each element is:

    • NA if the corresponding DOI is missing or syntactically invalid (no network call is made in this case) ;

    • TRUE if the DOI resolves successfully (HTTP 200 and responseCode == 1) ;

    • FALSE if the DOI is syntactically valid but does not resolve, or if the network request fails.

    If named = TRUE, the vector is named using the normalized DOI values (see .normalize_doi()).

    See also

    validate_references() for the full reference-validation pipeline that leverages DOI resolution among other matching strategies.

    Examples

    # \donttest{
# Single DOI - several input formats accepted
check_doi_exists("10.1126/science.169.3946.635")
#> [1] TRUE
check_doi_exists("https://doi.org/10.1126/science.169.3946.635")
#> [1] TRUE
check_doi_exists("doi:10.1126/science.169.3946.635")
#> [1] TRUE

# Multiple DOIs, unnamed result
dois <- c(
  "10.1126/science.169.3946.635",
  "10.9999/this-doi-does-not-exist",
  "not_a_doi_at_all",
  NA
)
check_doi_exists(dois)
#> [1]  TRUE FALSE    NA    NA

# Named result
check_doi_exists(dois, named = TRUE)
#>    10.1126/science.169.3946.635 10.9999/this-doi-does-not-exist 
#>                            TRUE                           FALSE 
#>                not_a_doi_at_all                            <NA> 
#>                              NA                              NA 
# }
